raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Group SANA-Video, SANA-WM and LongLive with Cosmos under NVIDIA.
- Move HY-Nomas into Tencent; combine MOVA/MOSS-Image under OpenMOSS and LingBot Video/World under Robbyant.
- Use publisher/team labels for FLUX (Black Forest Labs), LTX (Lightricks), JoyAI-Echo (JD.com), LongCat-Image (Meituan), Ming-Image (InclusionAI), ERNIE-Image (Baidu), Qwen-Image (Qwen), and Z-Image (Tongyi-MAI).
- Apply Black Forest Labs consistently to the existing VLA FLUX group and merge autoregressive ERNIE into the existing Baidu group.
- Preserve all page paths, URLs, content, and deployment configurations.

Only `docs/docs.json` changes.

Group by the publishing organization/team, not a model's base architecture or an ultimate corporate parent. Existing team groups such as Qwen and Wan remain separate; the model cards and modality-based cookbook landing pages are unchanged. Existing NEW tags are preserved.

## Attribution Checks

- [LongLive (NVIDIA)](https://nvlabs.github.io/LongLive/LongLive2/), [HY-Nomas (Tencent)](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-Nomas)
- [MOVA (OpenMOSS)](https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOVA), [Robbyant](https://huggingface.co/robbyant)
- [Black Forest Labs](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs), [LTX (Lightricks)](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2)
- [JoyAI-Echo (JD.com)](https://huggingface.co/jdopensource/JoyAI-Echo), [LongCat-Image (Meituan)](https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Image)
- [Ming-Image (InclusionAI)](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-Image-0.1-Design), [ERNIE-Image (Baidu)](https://huggingface.co/baidu/ERNIE-Image)
- [Qwen-Image (Qwen)](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image), [Z-Image (Tongyi-MAI)](https://huggingface.co/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo)

## Validation

- Cookbook config checker
- Navigation assertions: unchanged page multisets in all three cookbook sections, unique group names, expected publisher memberships, existing target files, preserved NEW tags
- Mintlify build validation and broken-link check
- Pre-commit for the changed file
